title: Canonical residue-field product decomposition of a reduced Artinian ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring which is Artinian (every descending chain of ideals stabilizes) and reduced (the only nilpotent element is zero). Let $M$ be the set of maximal ideals of $R$, where an ideal is maximal if it is proper and not strictly contained in another proper ideal. Then $M$ is finite, each quotient $R/\mathfrak m$, $\mathfrak m\in M$, is a field, and the canonical map $$R\longrightarrow\prod_{\mathfrak m\in M}R/\mathfrak m,\qquad r\longmapsto(r\bmod\mathfrak m)_{\mathfrak m\in M}$$ is an isomorphism of $R$-algebras. Quotients and their structural maps use [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. The zero ring is allowed, with $M=\varnothing$ and empty product the zero ring.
